1169-5078-5741-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-2113-3249-4054--52.easyPrerequisites:
Karametra's Favor attached to Grimgrin.
Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-2113-3249-4054--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Karametra's Favor by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Karametra's Favor by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that creature or when it enters, Primeval Bounty triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

requires.n: One-drop creature with a second body

1829-1957-4050--204.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the one-drop creature, adding {B}.
When that creature dies, it and Vindictive Vampire trigger.
Resolve the creature's ability, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Vindictive Vampire ability, gaining 1 life and causing Vindictive Vampire to deal 1 damage to each opponent.
When you gain life, Veinwitch Coven triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return the one-drop creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the token creature, adding one colored mana.
Cast the creature by paying one mana.
Repeat.

803-4302-6495.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
803-4302-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit token enters the battlefield as an Angel due to Arcane Adaptation, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
803-4302-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1874-1981-2415-8095.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1874-1981-2415-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Ajani's Welcome triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

2021-2060-6260-7741.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

1496-4399-4518-5998.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Grand Arbiter Augustin IV.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Verdant Sun's Avatar trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Verdant Sun's Avatar trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1496-4399-4518-5998.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

997-1806-2060-7367-7741.description:
Activate Eternal Scourge's scavenge ability, granted to it by Young Deathclaws, by paying {3} and exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard, putting six +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Shang-Chi.
Activate Crystalline Crawler six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {6}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Eternal Scourge.
Repeat.

2034-6248-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
2034-6248-7084.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Phenomenon Investigators and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Phenomenon Investigators trigger, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

527-1409-4068.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
527-1409-4068.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {3}{G}{U}.
Activate Selvala by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Selvala enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers, repairing it and Selvala.
Repeat.

2043-4659-6291-6671.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Magic Pot that is a 1/1 Soldier and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the Magic Pot token and the Thopter, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the Magic Pot token dies, it triggers, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Treasure or the Thopter, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

1143-2366-2713-4552-4893.description:
Activate Dryad Arbor by paying {0}, causing you to draw a card.
Dryad Arbor triggers, giving itself +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

5315-5361-5365.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Clue token.
Auton Soldier on the battlefield as a copy of Lonis.
5315-5361-5365.description:
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing a Clue.
Lonis and Auton Soldier's second abilities trigger.
Resolve the Lonis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Auton Soldier.
Auton Soldier's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Auton Soldier trigger from step 2, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lonis.
Lonis' first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Repeat.
5315-5361-5365.notes: You may optionally target any other creature using one of the triggers to put infinite +1/+1 counters on that creature.

4365-4871-6074.description:
During your upkeep, activate Nim Devourer by paying {B}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield, and then sacrificing it.
When Nim Devourer dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.

1636-4147-4215-5256.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional nontoken green creature.
Hua Tuo does not have summoning sickness.
1636-4147-4215-5256.description:
During your precombat main phase, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the additional nontoken green creature.
When the creature dies, Verdant Succession triggers.
Holding priority, activate Hua Tuo by tapping it, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for the sacrificed creature and putting it onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.

803-3168-4770-5613.notablePrerequisites: "Samurai" chosen with Urza's Incubator and Arcane Adaptation.
803-3168-4770-5613.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0}.
When Whitemane Lion enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

184-2097-3883.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two opponents.
184-2097-3883.description:
Activate Faerie Mastermind by paying {3}{U}, causing you to draw a card and create two Treasure artifact tokens for each opponent you have.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}.
Repeat.
If you have three or more opponents, this combo nets near-infinite Treasure tokens and colored mana.

678-1636-4050.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one creature card in hand.
Creatures you control can tap to produce enough mana to cast the creature card minus one colored mana.
You are able to cast the creature card in hand.
678-1636-4050.description:
Activate all mana-producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}.
Cast the creature card by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning the creature to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.

2233-3569-4924.notablePrerequisites: Myojin of Grim Betrayal has at least one indestructible counter on it.
2233-3569-4924.description:
Cast Pollenbright Druid by paying {G}.
Pollenbright Druid enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero or less toughness.
Pollenbright Druid's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin.
Activate Myojin by removing an indestructible counter from it, returning Pollenbright Druid from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2037-4658.notablePrerequisites:
Minsc & Boo has at least two loyalty counters on it.
Your life total is higher than or equal to an opponent's.
2037-4658.description:
Activate Minsc & Boo's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, sacrificing Soul of Eternity and dealing damage equal to Soul of Eternity's power to target opponent with a life total equal to or less than your life total.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 or less life.

3362-4050-4783.description:
Cast Hellkite Courser by paying {4}{R}{R}.
When Hellkite Courser enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Hellkite Courser, adding one mana of any color.
Resolve the Hellkite Courser trigger, putting Bladewing the Risen from the command zone onto the battlefield.
When Bladewing the Risen enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Bladewing the Risen, adding one mana of any color.
Choose to return Bladewing the Risen to the command zone from your graveyard.
Resolve the Bladewing the Risen trigger from step 5, returning Hellkite Courser from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Bladewing the Risen's ability.

1414-4195-4311-4574.description:
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it.
Ich-Tekik's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and each Golem you control.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Lotus Petal from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Lotus Petal from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat.

101-2103-4305.notablePrerequisites: Followed Footsteps attached to Vampire Charmseeker.
101-2103-4305.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Followed Footsteps triggers, creating a token copy of Vampire Charmseeker.
The Vampire Charmseeker token enters the battlefield, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

335-3333.description:
Cast Ad Nauseam by paying {3}{B}{B}.
Resolve Ad Nauseam, revealing the top card of your library, putting that card into your hand and losing no life due to Platinum Emperion
Repeat the process in step 2 as many times as desired.
